component.name: FyAgent
component.summary: All-in-One Assistant for Claude Code, Codex & Gemini CLI

description.p: FyAgent is a cross-platform desktop app for managing and switching provider configurations for Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
FyAgent is source-available; see the repository LICENSE for its mixed licensing terms.

ul.li: Manage multiple provider configurations and endpoints
One-click switch and sync to client live configurations
